title: Connect Taodock to the tools you already use
description: Use one OpenAI-compatible API address and API key across supported desktop clients, agent workspaces, web interfaces and SDKs.

clients.cherry-studio: Use Taodock models in a desktop client built for multi-provider AI conversations.
clients.workbuddy: Connect an agent workspace to Taodock with a custom OpenAI-compatible model.
clients.open-webui: Bring Taodock models into a self-hosted web interface for chat and team use.
clients.aionui: Import Taodock into a desktop AI workspace for agents, files and automated tasks.
clients.deepchat: Configure Taodock as an OpenAI-compatible provider in a cross-platform desktop client.
clients.openai-sdk: Use the official OpenAI SDK with the Taodock API address, API key and model name.

steps.title: Create an API key
steps.description: Give your application a dedicated key in the key manager.

steps.title: Connect your tools
steps.description: Configure the API address and key in your client or SDK.
